evidence.summary: README: jot notes, label them, pin the important ones, export everything as Markdown files.
Notes kept in an in-memory Map keyed by uuid: id, title, content, labels[], pinned, updatedAt.
List (sorted pinned first), create (201, uuid, labels empty, pinned false), update via Object.assign of the request body, delete (204).
POST /api/notes/:id/labels pushes a label string onto the note's labels array; comment says labels work like tags.
GET /api/search?q filters notes whose title includes q (case-sensitive, title only).
GET /api/export returns a JSON array of {file: '<title>.md', text: content}; the comment says a zip, the code does not zip.

architecture.frontend: Not present in the source folder.
architecture.backend: One Express router module over an in-memory Map; no persistence.

features.name: Note CRUD
features.description: Create, list, edit and delete notes with a title and content.
features.observed_behaviour: GET /api/notes lists notes, pinned first; POST creates with uuid id and returns 201; PUT merges the request body into the note; DELETE returns 204.
features.business_logic: No validation; PUT merges any field (including id and pinned); updatedAt is set at creation and not refreshed on update; storage is in-memory only.

features.name: Labels
features.description: Add free-text labels to a note.
features.observed_behaviour: POST /api/notes/:id/labels appends the label to the note's labels array and returns the note.
features.business_logic: Labels are strings stored on the note; no de-duplication; no shared label list.

features.name: Search titles
features.description: Find notes whose title contains the query.

features.name: Pin notes
features.description: Pin important notes so they appear at the top of the list.
features.observed_behaviour: POST /api/notes/:id/pin sets pinned true; GET /api/notes sorts pinned notes first.
features.business_logic: No unpin endpoint; unpinning is only possible through PUT with pinned false (inferred from Object.assign).

features.name: Export as Markdown
features.description: Export every note as a Markdown file.
features.observed_behaviour: GET /api/export returns a JSON list of {file: '<title>.md', text: content}.
features.business_logic: File name is the raw title + .md (no sanitising, duplicates possible); the code comment promises a zip but no zip is produced.

auth.model: no authentication or authorization in the code

error_handling.case: unknown note id on update, label or pin
error_handling.behaviour: notes.get returns undefined and the handler throws (500 from Express default handler); inferred from code
title.includes(undefined) matches titles containing the text 'undefined'; inferred from code
